visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female dermatologist with short brown hair and glasses, wearing a beige blazer over a white shirt, stands in a brightly lit office and speaks directly to the camera. The clinic logo is visible at the top. (2) As she discusses rosacea, several variety text overlays like '最難!' and animated spirals appear around her head. She uses active hand gestures to emphasize her points. (3) The scene shifts to include graphics indicating a '60-70%' probability and mentions of '蠕形蟎蟲' (demodex mites). (4) Photos of skin before and after treatment are displayed, followed by images of the 'Soolantra' medication box. (5) An animation showing a blood vessel (artery) with red blood cells moving through it illustrates the process of vessel dilation. (6) The doctor demonstrates treatment spots on her own cheek while a brief clip shows a patient undergoing a laser procedure with protective goggles. (7) She holds up a box of 'Dysport' (Botox) while explaining its use in very shallow injections. (8) The video concludes with a white information card displaying the clinic's logo, social media handle, phone number, and address details.
